title: Joash (king of Judah)
summary: King of Judah in Hales’s synopsis, “Joash or Jehoash”. Not the Joash of Raleigh’s Israel column. No earlier record of this king was in the data.
description: Added from the Hales import. Display only. Hales prints his own B.C. years in the synopsis and in Table XI. This chronology never sets a sort, and no tier 1–4 chronology dates this person’s birth, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year (Hales is display-only).

standby.note: Standby placement only. Chronological Framework of Ancient History prints this BC/AD year on the death entry (839 BC). It is not a sort year. No Anno Mundi, regnal length, or Julian Period figure was converted to obtain it.

birth.note: pending CFAH reference (no CFAH anchor point or Table 1 entry found for this)

reign.citation: Hales, A New Analysis of Chronology and Geography, History and Prophecy, 2nd ed., corrected and improved (London: C. J. G. & F. Rivington, 1830), vol. II, Synopsis of the Chronology, p. xxxv
reign.note: Kings of Judah. Not Raleigh’s Joash in the Israel column.

death.citation: Griffith & White, "A Reply to Beckman’s Defense of Thiele’s Chronology, Part 1: Jewish Sources for the Chronology of the Divided Kingdom," OSF preprint v1.4 (2025), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/XJZBM, section “Midrashic Literature”, item 1 (252 years), p. 6
